notes: This is the owner's garden/personal project, not part of the main production grove — has exactly 13 olive trees (owner-confirmed, this is the authoritative count, not an estimate) spread thinly over 6.26 stremmata (~2 trees/stremma, intentionally low density). No further planting is planned here despite the low density. There's a farm building complex on/next to the parcel (matches the name "Xoirostasio" = pig pen). Satellite detection found 19 blobs (est. 27) — this is KNOWN TO BE WRONG, likely picking up other garden vegetation/fruit trees rather than just the 13 olives, or misjudging clusters. Kept anyway at the owner's request, purely so this parcel has an image in the same format as the others; the owner will replace it with real per-tree positions once they're on-site, since eventually every parcel is meant to have actual tree locations mapped by hand rather than relying on satellite guesses.
